answer.item: Maki Zenin, Hagane Daido & Rokujushi Miyo vs. Naoya Zenin
Kappa Rokujushi is a headbutt attack performed by Rokujushi Miyo, an incarnated sumo enthusiast who participated in the Culling Game in the Sakurajima Colony.

questions.question: Who did Rokujushi use Kappa Rokujushi against?
questions.subject: Kappa Rokujushi

answer.item: Rokujushi used this technique against Naoya Zenin after he returned to life as a vengeful curse.

questions.question: What effect did the headbutt have during the fight?
questions.subject: Kappa Rokujushi

answer.item: The headbutt effectively staggered the cursed spirit, allowing Hagane Daido to cut him in half with the Split Soul Katana.
